name: agent-fleet
description: 通用多模型子任务执行工具:用 Claude Agent SDK 驱动自主 Agent,给它一个任务和一个模型(Gemini/DeepSeek/Kimi 或任意 Anthropic 兼容端点),bypassPermissions 权限跑到底,支持多任务并发跑不同模型。纯本地工具,不经过任何 Kollab 基础设施。

scripts.unit-test: node test/code-continue-test.mjs && node test/detach-say-test.mjs && node test/verdict-test.mjs && node test/control-unit-test.mjs && node test/dead-run-test.mjs && node test/shortcuts-test.mjs && node test/failure-report-test.mjs && node test/model-mapping-test.mjs && node test/team-test.mjs && node test/openai-bridge-test.mjs && node test/ledger-test.mjs && node test/timeline-test.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run unit-test && pnpm run smoke-test && pnpm run security-test && node test/fleet-go-test.mjs && python3 test/redact-test.py && python3 test/mini-test.py
scripts.check-sdk: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const pkg=require('./package.json');const cur=pkg.dependencies['@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk'];const latest=execSync('npm view @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk version').toString().trim();console.log('package.json 当前: '+cur+'  |  npm 最新: '+latest);"
